# Kastr

> Kastr is an iPhone app for diecast car collectors. It tells you, in the store aisle, whether you already own a car, whether it is a Treasure Hunt, and what it sold for recently. Free to download, iOS 17 or later. Independent, not affiliated with Mattel, Inc.

## What it does today

- Offline catalog of 78,256 diecast cars, from 1968 to this year's releases. Hot Wheels first, plus Matchbox, Mini GT, Tomica, M2 Machines, Maisto and Racing Champions.
- Search by name, year, series or toy number, free and unlimited, with no signal needed.
- Hunt: scan cards in a row (barcode and toy number read on the iPhone, AI identification as a fallback with the user's permission), then review. Each result shows "already in my garage", duplicate, and the car's rarity as listed in the catalog.
- The year's TH and STH list as a photo grid, with found cars ticked; a gold reveal with haptic feedback.
- Garage like a portfolio: price paid, value, makers, decades, rarities and series in progress; a wishlist; CSV import and export.
- Values from recent eBay sales and prices shared by collectors, converted to the local currency with European Central Bank rates, with the number of sales behind each value.
- "Where to find it": eBay listings open right now for a car (may be eBay Partner Network affiliate links).
- Completion tracking with medals. Dark and light themes, share card.

## Coming soon (not available yet)

- Community feed with reporting and blocking.

## Business model

- Free to download. No ads, no ad tracking.
- Kastr Pro is an optional auto-renewing subscription sold through the App Store. Prices are shown in the app.

## Data and privacy

- The collection is stored on the iPhone; an account (Sign in with Apple) is optional.
- Anonymous analytics (TelemetryDeck). Purchases via Apple and RevenueCat.
- AI identification of scans goes through our EU server to OpenAI, only with the user's permission.
- Catalog text data comes from Fandom wikis under CC BY-SA.

## FAQ

- Does Kastr work offline? Yes, the whole catalog is stored on the iPhone.
- Is Kastr on Android? Not yet; iPhone only.
- Is Kastr affiliated with Mattel? No. Hot Wheels and Matchbox are trademarks of Mattel, Inc.
